segments.name: Educational programs and services
segments.description: Delivers educational programs and services to undergraduate students, including NewSchool's architecture and design programs.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments. One reportable segment generates revenue from providing educational programs and services to undergraduate students.

segments.name: HybriU licensing and sales
segments.description: Sells and licenses HybriU AI-powered hybrid solutions for education, corporate conferencing and events.
segments.evidence: The other reportable segment generates revenue from the sales and licensing of HybriU solutions.

revenueModel.text: Students pay tuition and fees for educational programs, and customers pay for licensing and sales of HybriU solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue through the delivery of educational programs and licensing and sales of HybriU solutions.

changes.text: In 2023, the Board of Trustees voted to permanently close Bay State College at the end of the 2022-2023 academic year.
changes.evidence: On April 11, 2023, the Board of Trustees voted to permanently close Bay State College at the end of the 2022-2023 academic year, and this permanent closure was completed on August 31, 2023.
